about
Revolutionising delivery for the e-commerce era
At Relay, we’re rethinking delivery from the ground up - designed for speed, sustainability and efficiency. Our hyperlocal, tech-first network removes bottlenecks, reduces emissions and powers seamless e-commerce experiences.
WHY we're different
Smarter, faster and more sustainable
The traditional middle mile is gone

Legacy delivery networks rely on outdated hub-and-spoke models, causing delays, inefficiencies and unnecessary miles.

Relay replaces this rigid system with a flexible, scalable middle-mile network - built for modern e-commerce and optimised to move parcels across the country with precision and speed.

The last mile revolution

Our hyperlocal approach ensures that once parcels enter their final stage, they are delivered faster, greener and with fewer touchpoints.

By leveraging our distributed network and cutting-edge technology, we reduce infrastructure costs while enabling retailers to offer customers an elevated delivery experience.

Built by logistics & tech experts

Relay’s leadership team and advisors have years of experience in logistics and technology.
